searchText: makes sense from looking at the spreadsheet... The fix seems to be more important for small amounts of stake (likely solo stakers) 👍 Mind opening a PR? PTAL, https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4020 I much prefer this to the alternative: requiring their withdrawal addresses be the same. I’m still not totally convinced it’s a real problem, but this solution seems reasonable to me. I am not convinced that someone is willing to burn 32 ETH to cause legal implications and on the size of those implications vs amount of granted ETH. This change prevent an unauthorized action in principle which is good and also simplifies the protocol by restricting switch to compounding to a single place
